notes.title: Update 1.102
notes.notes:
Hey! A small update today to add the screenshots camera, which now sits on the left of the table in the sanbox. Hold onto it and click the trackpad to take a screenshot to your Pictures folder (User/Pictures/Shotforge/). 

And also a couple minor fixes for throwing uncomposed parts and for composing a weapon when it doesn't have any grips, rendering it unusable.
